status: PASS for real-weight one-token and multi-token inference (QUORTEX == llama.cpp); fp64 reference has a known remaining layout bug (documented)

model.sha256_verified: bit-exact match with publisher LFS oid
model.architecture: qwen3next: 48 blocks (36 Gated DeltaNet + 12 full attention every 4th), GQA 16/2 heads x 256 dim (rot 64, base 5e6), MoE 512 experts top-10 + shared expert, GDN ssm state 128 x inner 4096 (32 v-heads), conv kernel 4, embd 2048, vocab 151936
model.quantization: Q4_K_M (file_type 15); tensors: Q4_K x389, Q5_K x36, Q6_K x57, BF16 x48, F32 x313

architecture_requirements.attention: gated GQA: fused q+gate projection, per-head q/k RMS norm, partial RoPE (64 of 256), sigmoid gate on attention output
architecture_requirements.gated_delta_net: fused qkv+gate projections, depthwise causal conv (kernel 4, SiLU), per-head L2 norm on q/k, per-v-head (beta sigmoid, log-decay softplus*A), recurrent delta rule with decaying state [128,128] per v-head, gated RMS norm with z (SiLU) gate
architecture_requirements.moe: softmax router top-10, renormalized weights, per-expert silu(gate)*up->down (3-D expert tensors, streamed per-expert slices), shared expert with sigmoid input gate
architecture_requirements.recurrent_state: conv state 3x8192 + ssm state 128x128x32 floats per GDN block (2.1 MB/block, 76 MB total), KV cache for 12 attention blocks (2.5 MB at ctx 64)

synthetic_validation.ops_verified_exact: rms norm 6e-10; attention block end-to-end 1e-4; MoE incl routing 4e-8; GDN: projections/qkv/conv/L2/repeat/delta-net/gated-norm all 0.0-1e-7 vs ggml
key_layout_findings: ggml K-quant to_float interleaves nibble halves per 32 bytes (dequantize_row_*), NOT [all-lows, all-highs]
ggml flat order is ne0-fastest: true [in][out] needs reshape(d1,d0).T from raw dumps
GDN q/k/v channels are head-minor (i + head*dim)
GDN k-head->v-head expansion: v-head h uses k-head h//2 (repeat-merge h = r + 2g, not interleaved r*4+g)
z gate and ssm_norm are per (head_v_dim) with channels i + h*HV
bugs_found_and_fixed: fp64 ref: ggml 2-D weight reshape was flat-faithful but indexed as [in][out] (scrambled); fixed via reshape(d1,d0).T
fp64 ref: conv1d kernel indexing ignored ggml (j,c) at j+c*4 packing
fp64 ref: embedding row decode used non-interleaved nibble order
adapter: router weight indexed [in][out] vs loaded [out][in] -> wrong expert selection (THE decisive bug)
adapter: recurrent-state slots indexed by cumulative token counter -> overflow at token 2 (reset per token, per-layer slots)
